# Shared machines
<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-agent-context.py from tooling/agent-context/sites/bnl-sdcc.yaml in eic/skills. Manual changes will be lost. -->

- `eicsub02.sdcc.bnl.gov` is a login node shared with other users: for editing, light tests
  and job submission. **Do NOT** run an analysis over a large dataset there; submit it
  as a batch job with a time limit, after testing on one file.
- Batch system: HTCondor. Submit with `condor_submit`, check with
  `condor_q`, cancel your own jobs with `condor_rm`.
- Home: `/eic/u/<user>`.
  Scratch for large outputs: not recorded here, ask the user.
- **Do NOT** leave background processes behind on a login node.
